messages.subject: unite function creates a strange methylBase object
messages.subject_clean: unite function creates a strange methylBase object
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
Any idea why uniting the filtered object with the following code meth=unite(filtered.myobj, destrand=T) results in methBase object (table 1) and not the one underneath (table 2)?

Table 1
methylBase object with 0 rows
--------------
  [1] chr         start       end         strand      coverage1   numCs1
  [7] numTs1      coverage2   numCs2      numTs2      coverage3   numCs3
 [13] numTs3      coverage4   numCs4      numTs4      coverage5   numCs5
 [19] numTs5      coverage6   numCs6      numTs6      coverage7   numCs7
 [25] numTs7      coverage8   numCs8      numTs8      coverage9   numCs9
 [31] numTs9      coverage10  numCs10     numTs10     coverage11  numCs11
 [37] numTs11     coverage12  numCs12     numTs12     coverage13  numCs13
 [43] numTs13     coverage14  numCs14     numTs14     coverage15  numCs15
 [49] numTs15     coverage16  numCs16     numTs16     coverage17  numCs17

Table 2
      coverage120 numCs120 numTs120 coverage121 numCs121 numTs121
1          18       13        5          18       13        5
2          16        2       14          16        2       14
3           8        8        0           8        8        0
4          22       20        2          22       20        2
5          45       42        3          45       42        3
6          22        0       22          22        0       22

I thought the problem could come from the way treatment is read in ( as.integer, or as.numeric) but the error persisted.
I am working with 121 samples so I tried splitting the data into two smaller batches to see if there is a corrupt sample but when I loaded the files in smaller batched everything was normal.
Any thoughts as to what could be happening?

Thanks in advance,
LK
